title: Snap points
text: Opens at set heights that users switch between by dragging or with the keyboard.

title: Drag to dismiss
text: Dragging down closes the sheet, and a close button is always there as well.

title: Modal or not
text: Modal sheets make the page inert; non-modal ones leave it usable.

title: Cancelable close
text: Escape, backdrop, and drag-down raise a cancel event you can veto.
